decisions.reason: As a large machinery maker with strong in-house R&D, service capabilities and deep knowledge in coolant handling, the firm can readily improve and integrate this booster system into its core offer.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's established filtration and process-media competencies, so absorptive capacity is high and early market learning is likely to support refinement rather than withdrawal.

Coolant nozzles are closely related to the existing coolant-management business and complement system sales, although as a smaller and more easily substituted component they face a slightly higher rationalisation risk than the larger systems.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's established conveying portfolio, and the firm's engineering base and broad customer access make it likely to retain and iterate this variant.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds directly on the firm's material-flow and chip-management know-how, giving it a strong basis to learn from demand and keep the product on the market.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is well within the firm's existing conveyor competence set, and a broad modular portfolio is strategically valuable even if some overlap makes pruning marginally possible.
